name: backgrounded-git-push-to-main-still-asks-for-picto
note: Sibling of the redirection evasion: a trailing background `&` is a control operator the tokenizer keeps as a word, so it would otherwise land in the refspec position (`git.push:refs/heads/&`). strip_redirections drops the lone `&`, and the charset on the bash-git-push `ref` capture is the defense-in-depth backstop on the raw command.
